system.perspective.print("updatePopupSelection msg received with %s"%payload)

	if payload['msgHandler'] == 'maintenanceTypeSelected': 
		if len(payload['selection']) > 0: selection = payload['selection'][0]['value']
		else:
			selection = {
						"changedBy": None,
						"changedDate": None,
						"createdBy": None,
						"createdDate": None,
						"enabled": True,
						"maintenanceTypeId": None,
						"label": None,
						"parentId": None,
						"path": None,
						"treeLevel": None
						}
	
		self.view.custom.maintenanceTypes.selected = selection
	
	return
